units.rawText: I'm surprised you chose to meet at the Karaoke and not the stage, Nanaka.
units.displayText: I'm surprised you chose to meet at the Karaoke and not the stage, Nanaka.

spans.text: I'm surprised you chose to meet at the Karaoke and not the stage, Nanaka.

units.rawText: I can't be alone with you if we're on the stage, Professor. After all, you're Nanaka's most important fan, and you deserve my very special fan service~
units.displayText: I can't be alone with you if we're on the stage, Professor. After all, you're Nanaka's most important fan, and you deserve my very special fan service~

spans.text: I can't be alone with you if we're on the stage, Professor. After all, you're Nanaka's most important fan, and you deserve my very special fan service~

units.rawText: Nanaka really hasn't changed one bit. I remember; you were also singing when we first met.
units.displayText: Nanaka really hasn't changed one bit. I remember; you were also singing when we first met.

spans.text: Nanaka really hasn't changed one bit. I remember; you were also singing when we first met.

units.rawText: I was just so very happy that I could join the Oasis. Hehehe, was it love at first sight for my biggest fan?
units.displayText: I was just so very happy that I could join the Oasis. Hehehe, was it love at first sight for my biggest fan?

spans.text: I was just so very happy that I could join the Oasis. Hehehe, was it love at first sight for my biggest fan?

units.rawText: Mm, I've been Nanaka's fan ever since that day.
units.displayText: Mm, I've been Nanaka's fan ever since that day.

spans.text: Mm, I've been Nanaka's fan ever since that day.

units.rawText: You weren't supposed to say that so directly! Still, it makes me really happy to hear that!
units.displayText: You weren't supposed to say that so directly! Still, it makes me really happy to hear that!

spans.text: You weren't supposed to say that so directly! Still, it makes me really happy to hear that!

units.rawText: Alright, let's get the fan service started...
units.displayText: Alright, let's get the fan service started...

spans.text: Alright, let's get the fan service started...

units.rawText: Nanaka picks up the mic, putting it in front of her chest.
units.displayText: Nanaka picks up the mic, putting it in front of her chest.

spans.text: Nanaka picks up the mic, putting it in front of her chest.

units.rawText: Professor, I know you will face many obstacles... and the battles ahead will not be easy.
units.displayText: Professor, I know you will face many obstacles... and the battles ahead will not be easy.

spans.text: Professor, I know you will face many obstacles... and the battles ahead will not be easy.

units.rawText: That being said... whenever you need me, I'll use my song to brighten your day, Professor.
units.displayText: That being said... whenever you need me, I'll use my song to brighten your day, Professor.

spans.text: That being said... whenever you need me, I'll use my song to brighten your day, Professor.

units.rawText: Now, please listen to the new song I wrote just for you—The Oasis.
units.displayText: Now, please listen to the new song I wrote just for you—The Oasis.
